Hey Guys, I have recently visited Alibaug which is also called mini Goa.
There are 2 ways to reach Alibaug, one is Roadways and another is Waterways.
Mumbai to Alibaug is 95kms, it takes 3-4 hrs to reach Alibaug.
By road you can go by MSRTC Govt bus or by your own private vehicle.
By waterways, you can get a normal ferry from Gateway of India till Madwa Jetty.
It costs 120rs per person and in that ticket Madwa to Alibaug bus ticket is also included.
Second waterways option is M2M Roro service from Bhau cha Dhakka.
From M2M roro you can take your vehicle & pet with you, for booking check the link below.
In this video, I have shared proper 2Days 1Night itinerary of Alibaug Tourist Places with all the detailed information.
